description: This file implements a service class in Java for reading and retrieving loan collateral management data within the Fineract project. It provides methods to fetch collateral details for specific loans, individual collateral data, and lists of collateral data, utilizing repository classes and security context for user authentication.

classes.name: LoanCollateralManagementReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a service interface for reading loan collateral management data, fetching collateral information related to loans, and calculating total collateral value.

methods.name: getLoanCollaterals
methods.description: Retrieves a list of collateral management entities associated with a specific loan identified by loanId.

methods.name: getLoanCollateralResponseData
methods.description: Fetches detailed response data for a specific collateral identified by collateralId, including total value calculations.

methods.name: getLoanCollateralResponseDataList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of response data objects for all collaterals associated with a specified loan.
